title: Turn off unnecessary animation
summary: Chart animation can be disabled when it is not useful.
introduction: Chart animation can be disabled when it is not useful. Your task: Compare a chart update with animation on and off.
learningObjectives: Compare a chart update with animation on and off.
Explain the example for turn off unnecessary animation

blocks.text: Chart animation can be disabled when it is not useful. This can make repeated updates easier to follow and reduce motion.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Turn off unnecessary animation

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`animation: false` draws the chart without a tweened transition.
`maintainAspectRatio: false` lets the Chart.js canvas use the explicit height of its parent holder.

blocks.text: The chart draws directly without an animated transition.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Respect reduced-motion preferences when choosing animation. Movement should not carry the only explanation of a change.
